title: Learn React.js from Scratch
description: Learn React – the most popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Build modern web apps using components, hooks, state management, and routing in this hands-on, project-oriented course.

Syllabus.title: Introduction to React
Syllabus.description: Understand what React is, why it's useful, and how it fits into modern web development.
Lesson: Setting up your first React app (Vite or CRA)

Syllabus.title: JSX and Rendering
Syllabus.description: Learn JSX syntax and how React renders UI.

Syllabus.title: Components and Props
Syllabus.description: Build UI with reusable components and pass data using props.

Syllabus.title: State and Events
Syllabus.description: Use React's state to manage data and respond to user input.

Syllabus.title: Conditional Rendering and Lists
Syllabus.description: Render UI conditionally and display lists dynamically.

Syllabus.title: Forms and Input Handling
Syllabus.description: Create and handle forms using React best practices.

Syllabus.title: useEffect and Lifecycle
Syllabus.description: Fetch data and react to changes using lifecycle hooks.

Syllabus.title: Component Communication
Syllabus.description: Pass data between components and lift state up.

Syllabus.title: React Router
Syllabus.description: Create single-page applications with navigation and routing.

Syllabus.title: Styling in React
Syllabus.description: Style your React components using various techniques.

Syllabus.title: Context API and Global State
Syllabus.description: Manage global application state using React Context.

Syllabus.title: Deploying React Apps
Syllabus.description: Take your React app live on the internet.
